notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original full primary source unavailable after bounded open-access acquisition. Secondary original values in the replication authors’ workbook were not extracted as primary original evidence. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative.
Source follow-up: Published primary article title, authors, year and DOI verified from supplied text first page. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Table 8 is the supplied p.20 locator. Requested r is extracted as the explicitly printed uncorrected mean correlation Mr̂; the same row separately prints corrected estimated mean population correlation Mρ̂ = -.28. No conversion performed. Table reports a 95% CI for corrected Mρ̂, but no p value for this association; no p inferred from its confidence interval. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders as required.
